t.why: A major country of origin and transit for migration to the United States.
t.rel: It has taken its territorial dispute with neighboring Belize to the International Court of Justice. It manages migration toward the United States together with Mexico, and with El Salvador and Honduras it forms Central America's Northern Triangle, handling security and migration together.
t.know: A little over 40% of the population is Indigenous Maya, and more than 20 Mayan languages are spoken.
t.etext: Central America's largest economy, selling coffee, bananas, cardamom and sugar. Remittances from people working in the United States are a big part of the economy.
